children: Meey Global, a Cayman Islands holding company operating a real estate technology ecosystem in Vietnam through its subsidiaries, filed for an initial public offering on the Nasdaq Capital Market. The offering size, price range, and ticker were not disclosed in the preliminary F-1. The company plans to use proceeds to expand product development, data and AI capabilities, marketing, geographic reach, and general corporate purposes.

Meey Global is a Cayman Islands holding company that conducts operations in Vietnam through its subsidiaries, led by Meey Land Group Joint Stock Company. The company develops and runs a vertically integrated property technology ecosystem designed to modernize Vietnam’s real estate market by improving data transparency, valuation accuracy, and transaction efficiency. Its platform suite includes Meeyland.com (a property listing and discovery portal), Meey Map (land-use planning and cadastral intelligence), Meey Value (an automated valuation model), Meey Atlas (national-scale mapping), Meey CRM (broker workflow and client management), Meey Ads (real estate-focused digital advertising), Meey 3D (virtual tour creation), Meey Project (project data hub), and Meey ID (unified identity and authentication).

Meey Global generates revenue from software sales and technical services, subscription plans for search and CRM features, and advertising services. The company emphasizes AI and machine learning across its products—such as listing verification, AVM pricing, geospatial extraction and search, and buyer-property matching—while building proprietary geospatial infrastructure to support national-scale, data-driven real estate applications. It plans to deepen its presence across Vietnam and expand into selected Southeast Asian markets with similar market structures.
: Vietnam’s PropTech platform market was approximately $306.5 million in 2025 and is projected to reach about $717.5 million by 2030.
: Forecast compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 18.5% for Vietnam’s PropTech platform market from 2025 to 2030; online transaction value expected to grow to $22.0 billion by 2030.
: Operates an integrated ecosystem spanning listings, land-use mapping, automated valuation, CRM, and geospatial infrastructure; among the most comprehensive platforms in Vietnam.
: Batdongsan.com.vn (PropertyGuru), Cafeland, Alonhadat, Chotot (Nhatot), Homedy, Mogi; international comparables include Zillow, Rightmove, and CoStar/LoopNet.
: ROI-focused AI deployment, data governance as a core advantage, and migration from point tools to integrated end-to-end platforms.
: 12 of 49 Vietnamese commercial banks reportedly use products within the ecosystem; about 30 licensed valuation companies and over 200 real estate trading floors use enterprise solutions.
: Approximately 28 representative offices across Vietnam’s major cities and growth provinces.
: Principal operations in Vietnam with planned expansion into Southeast Asia.
: Relationships with banks, valuation firms, real estate agencies and developers; technology partners include AWS and CMC Telecom.
: Industry online transaction value projected to reach $22.0 billion by 2030 (market-level metric).
: Platform averaged over 256,000 active property listings in FY2026; apps downloaded 300,000+ times; user ratings reportedly 4.5–4.7/5 based on 8,000+ reviews.
, Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer - Founder and leader of Meey Land; background in technology and telecom services; B.S. in Applied Mathematics & Informatics.
, Chief Executive Officer Nominee and Director Nominee - Former Head of Business at a deep tech network project; blockchain advisor; holds master’s degrees in management/logistics and engineering.
, Chief Financial Officer Nominee and Director Nominee - CFO of Meey Land since 2022; prior finance leadership at R&H Group and Vinaconex; master’s in finance-banking.
